name_input: DOLPHY INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; DOLPHY INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; DOLPHY INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; DOLPHY INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; DOLPHY INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for DOLPHY INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED (https://importkey.com/countries/india/dolphy-india-private-limited) lists outbound rows, e.g. exact line: "2026-02-02 DOLPHY INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED SAMLING HOTELS ESSENTIALS PC PREMIUM SOAP DISPENSER 200ML GREY- LCS JAIGAON INJIGB, India Phuntsholing, BHUTAN 39249090 9297517" and "2026-01-30 DOLPHY INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED ZAKHER BUILDING SOLUTIONS LLC. DSDR0117 Main PCB Sensor With IndicatorLight - DSDR117-PCB- SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4, India MUSCAT, OMAN 85369090 9201390". Counter check: page header states "Total Shipments 2546 Records detected", "Trading Partners 13", "Ports 27", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-12"; the free view rendered only 5 shipment rows (2 of them outbound: Bhutan 2026-02-02 B/L 9297517, Oman 2026-01-30 B/L 9201390; the other 3 are inbound from China). So 2 export rows actually seen vs 2546 total records claimed — the 2546 figure is not independently verifiable on the free view.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) and the company site https://www.dolphyindia.com/ failed with SSL certificate verification error, so no domestic supply record was read. Buyer-side rows on the same ImportKey page (e.g. "SAMLING HOTEL ESSENTIALS JANTA BARTAN BHANDAR ... THIMPU BHUTAN", "ORION PEST SOLUTIONS PVT LTD ... BIRATNAGAR NEPAL") are counterparty aggregations, not Dolphy domestic invoices, and are not treated as domestic evidence.
note: Export side is factually supported: two dated outbound customs records with destination, HS code and B/L number (Bhutan 2026-02-02, HS 39249090, B/L 9297517; Oman 2026-01-30, HS 85369090, B/L 9201390). Declared HS 330510 (shampoo) and 700991 (unframed glass mirrors) do NOT match any observed shipment line — observed codes are 39249090 (soap dispenser), 85369090 (PCB sensor), plus inbound 87168010, 85163300, 85171890. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: company stays in the base, HS should be corrected to the actual observed codes, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Business profile is hotel/bathroom-accessory supply (soap dispensers, hand dryers, telephones, trolleys), not food/FMCG as claimed. Domestic supply evidence: not found in accessible sources — stated as unknown, not as 'conditionally accepted'. Revenue and export volume: null, not public in the free view. Second sources (volza 403, eximpedia/importgenius/trademo not reached within the 10-call budget) could not be cross-checked.
